keys: Every reel locked is a reel that pays. The machine is held still and charged for it, and the charge comes back with interest.
en: Every reel locked is a reel that pays. The machine is held still and charged for it, and the charge comes back with interest.
fr: Chaque rouleau bloqué est un rouleau qui paie. La machine est immobilisée et facturée pour cela, et la note revient avec intérêts.

keys: Spins bought, spins refunded, and boilers that pay nothing until they light. The build that plays the floor's time as a resource.
en: Spins bought, spins refunded, and boilers that pay nothing until they light. The build that plays the floor's time as a resource.
fr: Des lancers achetés, des lancers remboursés, et des chaudières qui ne paient rien tant qu'elles ne sont pas allumées. Le montage qui joue le temps de l'étage comme une ressource.

keys: Many small devices, each firing on every line, and a switchboard that pays by the trigger. The build that is more than the sum of its trinkets.
en: Many small devices, each firing on every line, and a switchboard that pays by the trigger. The build that is more than the sum of its trinkets.
fr: De nombreux petits appareils, chacun se déclenchant sur chaque ligne, et un central qui paie au déclenchement. Le montage qui vaut plus que la somme de ses babioles.

keys: The debt is the build. Every hundred owed is leverage, every creditor on the machine a multiplier, and paying it down is the one thing the build cannot afford.
en: The debt is the build. Every hundred owed is leverage, every creditor on the machine a multiplier, and paying it down is the one thing the build cannot afford.
fr: La dette, c'est le montage. Chaque centaine due est un effet de levier, chaque créancier sur la machine un multiplicateur, et la rembourser est la seule chose que le montage ne peut se permettre.

keys: The ledger of everything that has ever landed. Fruit by the bushel, sevens by the count, and a multiplier that has been growing since the basement.
en: The ledger of everything that has ever landed. Fruit by the bushel, sevens by the count, and a multiplier that has been growing since the basement.
fr: Le grand livre de tout ce qui est jamais tombé. Des fruits au boisseau, des sept par dizaines, et un multiplicateur qui grossit depuis le sous-sol.

en: Skulls on the reel, skulls on the payroll, and a book that pays more the more of them stand. The House's own curse, turned into wages.

en: THE CLERK — The ante is due when the spins run out. Cover it or the House keeps the table — and the surety on the account is you. The column on the right is how much of you it holds; watch it. Cover the ante with spins to spare and you may SETTLE early: the House pays you in chips for every spin you leave — twice over, with half of them still on the clock. Chips buy hardware. Credits pay the ante. They never mix.
fr: LE COMMIS — L'ante est due quand les lancers sont épuisés. Couvrez-la, ou la Maison garde la table — et la caution sur le compte, c'est vous. La colonne à droite indique la part de vous qu'elle détient ; surveillez-la. Couvrez l'ante avec des lancers en réserve, et vous pourrez RÉGLER par anticipation : la Maison vous paie en jetons pour chaque lancer que vous laissez — le double, la moitié restant encore au compteur. Les jetons achètent du matériel. Les crédits paient l'ante. Ils ne se mélangent jamais.

keys: THE CLERK — The draft. Chips buy hardware; hardware bolts on and stays. What you cannot afford, you may sign for — on the slate, against the debt, at the House's rate. Win loudly and the House notices: it sends one more of its people to the next floor, and says so. The doorman on this form takes chips to send nobody. From the next floor the draft may deal a chit — paper, spent once, at its moment. Everything else the House will explain when it charges you for it.
en: THE CLERK — The draft. Chips buy hardware; hardware bolts on and stays. What you cannot afford, you may sign for — on the slate, against the debt, at the House's rate. Win loudly and the House notices: it sends one more of its people to the next floor, and says so. The doorman on this form takes chips to send nobody. From the next floor the draft may deal a chit — paper, spent once, at its moment. Everything else the House will explain when it charges you for it.
fr: LE COMMIS — Le tirage. Les jetons achètent du matériel ; le matériel se boulonne et reste. Ce que vous ne pouvez pas vous offrir, vous pouvez le signer — sur l'ardoise, contre la dette, au taux de la Maison. Gagnez bruyamment et la Maison le remarque : elle envoie un de ses gens de plus à l'étage suivant, et le dit. Le portier, sur ce formulaire, prend des jetons pour n'envoyer personne. À partir de l'étage suivant, le tirage peut distribuer un bon — du papier, dépensé une fois, en son moment. Pour le reste, la Maison vous l'expliquera quand elle vous le facturera.

keys: A drum held is a drum that pays. +1.0x per reel held for the spin.
en: A drum held is a drum that pays. +1.0x per reel held for the spin.
fr: Un tambour retenu est un tambour qui paie. +1,0x par rouleau retenu pour le lancer.

keys: Signed, and worth more the longer it stands. +0.12x per 100 owed, up to +1.2x.
en: Signed, and worth more the longer it stands. +0.12x per 100 owed, up to +1.2x.
fr: Signé, et qui vaut d'autant plus qu'il dure. +0,12x par tranche de 100 dus, jusqu'à +1,2x.

keys: Two more teeth on the wheel. Every award the machine makes carries 2 more nudges.
en: Two more teeth on the wheel. Every award the machine makes carries 2 more nudges.
fr: Deux dents de plus sur la roue. Chaque récompense de la machine porte 2 poussées de plus.

keys: Everything on the floor runs through it. +0.45x per other device that fired.
en: Everything on the floor runs through it. +0.45x per other device that fired.
fr: Tout, sur l'étage, passe par elle. +0,45x par autre appareil qui s'est déclenché.

keys: Time not spent is time paid for. +0.5x per spin still left on the floor, up to +6.0x.
en: Time not spent is time paid for. +0.5x per spin still left on the floor, up to +6.0x.
fr: Le temps non dépensé est un temps payé. +0,5x par lancer restant sur l'étage, jusqu'à +6,0x.

keys: Every step of it, paid at the end. +3.6x per nudge spent on the board.
en: Every step of it, paid at the end. +3.6x per nudge spent on the board.
fr: Chaque pas, payé à la fin. +3,6x par poussée dépensée sur le plateau.

keys: Every stop the drum is told to make. +1.0x per nudge spent on the board.
en: Every stop the drum is told to make. +1.0x per nudge spent on the board.
fr: Chaque arrêt que le tambour reçoit l'ordre de faire. +1,0x par poussée dépensée sur le plateau.

keys: It does not let go, and it charges for the grip. +4.5x per reel held for the spin.
en: It does not let go, and it charges for the grip. +4.5x per reel held for the spin.
fr: Il ne lâche jamais, et il facture la prise. +4,5x par rouleau retenu pour le lancer.

keys: The House pays for the ones it buries. +0.35x per skull standing.
en: The House pays for the ones it buries. +0.35x per skull standing.
fr: La Maison paie pour ceux qu'elle enterre. +0,35x par crâne debout.

keys: Every bushel counted since the basement. +0.11x per fruit landed this run, up to +13.0x.
en: Every bushel counted since the basement. +0.11x per fruit landed this run, up to +13.0x.
fr: Chaque boisseau compté depuis le sous-sol. +0,11x par fruit tombé cette partie, jusqu'à +13,0x.

keys: Three more pulls, taken out of the bars, which pay 10 less for the floor.
en: Three more pulls, taken out of the bars, which pay 10 less for the floor.
fr: Trois lancers de plus, prélevés sur les Bars, qui paient 10 de moins pour l'étage.

keys: The sevens are gilded for the night. The floor is a quarter dearer for the gold.
en: The sevens are gilded for the night. The floor is a quarter dearer for the gold.
fr: Les sept chanceux sont dorés pour la nuit. L'étage coûte un quart de plus pour cet or.

keys: Paid in full and in the House's own paper. The drums stop where they stop.
en: Paid in full and in the House's own paper. The drums stop where they stop.
fr: Payé intégralement, et dans le papier de la Maison elle-même. Les tambours s'arrêtent où ils s'arrêtent.

keys: The interest sleeps while you do not. Two fewer pulls on the floor for it.
en: The interest sleeps while you do not. Two fewer pulls on the floor for it.
fr: L'intérêt dort pendant que vous ne dormez pas. Deux lancers de moins sur l'étage, en échange.

keys: Nobody asks where it came from. The interest asks for everything else.
en: Nobody asks where it came from. The interest asks for everything else.
fr: Personne ne demande d'où ça vient. L'intérêt, lui, demande tout le reste.

keys: Paid by the stop, not by the hour. Every award carries a nudge; the ante is 15% dearer.
en: Paid by the stop, not by the hour. Every award carries a nudge; the ante is 15% dearer.
fr: Payé à l'arrêt, pas à l'heure. Chaque récompense porte une poussée ; l'ante coûte 15 % de plus.

keys: The dead are on the payroll, and the House is hiring. Skulls pay 8; more of them are printed.
en: The dead are on the payroll, and the House is hiring. Skulls pay 8; more of them are printed.
fr: Les morts sont sur la paie, et la Maison embauche. Les crânes paient 8 ; on en imprime davantage.

keys: The whole line pays, and everything short of it pays 20% less.
en: The whole line pays, and everything short of it pays 20% less.
fr: La ligne entière paie, et tout ce qui n'y arrive pas paie 20 % de moins.

keys: The sevens come up from the store. Something has to go back down.
en: The sevens come up from the store. Something has to go back down.
fr: Les sept chanceux remontent de la réserve. Quelque chose doit redescendre.

keys: The whole line pays four times over. Everything short of it pays 8% less.
en: The whole line pays four times over. Everything short of it pays 8% less.
fr: La ligne entière paie quatre fois sa valeur. Tout ce qui n'y arrive pas paie 8 % de moins.

keys: The next spin, the last drum lands on a double bar. An old schedule, still honoured.
en: The next spin, the last drum lands on a double bar. An old schedule, still honoured.
fr: Au prochain lancer, le dernier tambour s'arrête sur un Double Bar. Un vieux barème, toujours honoré.

keys: The next spin, the last drum lands on a skull. Cheap, for obvious reasons, and worth it to a payroll.
en: The next spin, the last drum lands on a skull. Cheap, for obvious reasons, and worth it to a payroll.
fr: Au prochain lancer, le dernier tambour s'arrête sur un crâne. Bon marché, pour des raisons évidentes, et rentable pour une paie.

keys: A window open somewhere. Eighteen off the count, and nobody says who opened it.
en: A window open somewhere. Eighteen off the count, and nobody says who opened it.
fr: Une fenêtre ouverte quelque part. Dix-huit de moins sur la surveillance, et personne ne dit qui l'a ouverte.

keys: The floor's interest is added to the principal instead of taken. The House is patient at a price.
en: The floor's interest is added to the principal instead of taken. The House is patient at a price.
fr: L'intérêt de l'étage s'ajoute au principal au lieu d'être prélevé. La Maison est patiente, à un prix.

keys: The whole room cleared of it. Seventy off the count, on the floor where the count is the game.
en: The whole room cleared of it. Seventy off the count, on the floor where the count is the game.
fr: Toute la salle en est débarrassée. Soixante-dix de moins sur la surveillance, sur l'étage où la surveillance est le jeu.

keys: The next line, printed before it is spun. Knowing late is still knowing.
en: The next line, printed before it is spun. Knowing late is still knowing.
fr: La prochaine ligne, imprimée avant même le lancer. Savoir tard, c'est savoir quand même.

keys: The last drum, turned again while the decision stands. Dearer up here, and worth more.
en: The last drum, turned again while the decision stands. Dearer up here, and worth more.
fr: Le dernier tambour, tourné à nouveau tant que la décision tient. Plus cher ici, et ça vaut plus.

keys: The next spin, the last drum lands on a seven. Marked by somebody who owed a favour.
en: The next spin, the last drum lands on a seven. Marked by somebody who owed a favour.
fr: Au prochain lancer, le dernier tambour s'arrête sur un sept. Marqué par quelqu'un qui devait un service.

keys: A door left open somewhere. Eighteen off the count, and nobody says who left it.
en: A door left open somewhere. Eighteen off the count, and nobody says who left it.
fr: Une porte laissée ouverte quelque part. Dix-huit de moins sur la surveillance, et personne ne dit qui l'a laissée.

keys: Three more stops, taken rather than given. Nobody asks where it came from.
en: Three more stops, taken rather than given. Nobody asks where it came from.
fr: Trois arrêts de plus, pris plutôt que donnés. Personne ne demande d'où ça vient.

keys: Two more pulls on a floor that was closing. Signed by somebody on the night shift.
en: Two more pulls on a floor that was closing. Signed by somebody on the night shift.
fr: Deux lancers de plus sur un étage qui fermait. Signé par quelqu'un de l'équipe de nuit.

keys: Five more pulls, and the doors stay as they are. The House charges for the hour, not the hospitality.
en: Five more pulls, and the doors stay as they are. The House charges for the hour, not the hospitality.
fr: Cinq lancers de plus, et les portes restent telles quelles. La Maison facture l'heure, pas l'hospitalité.

keys: One more stop on a board that has already landed. Somebody left it under the drum.
en: One more stop on a board that has already landed. Somebody left it under the drum.
fr: Un arrêt de plus sur un plateau déjà posé. Quelqu'un l'a laissé sous le tambour.

en: Every bell is gilded 18 above its face. Everything the machine pays comes back 10% lighter for the metal.

keys: Three more pulls at the machine. The floor is 30% dearer to leave for them.
en: Three more pulls at the machine. The floor is 30% dearer to leave for them.
fr: Trois lancers de plus à la machine. L'étage coûte 30 % de plus à quitter, en échange.

keys: The desk will take 30% less to let the floor go. It keeps 15% of everything the machine pays instead.
en: The desk will take 30% less to let the floor go. It keeps 15% of everything the machine pays instead.
fr: Le bureau prendra 30 % de moins pour vous laisser quitter l'étage. Il garde en échange 15 % de tout ce que la machine paie.

keys: Everything pays 70% more tonight. The ante is up a fifth, and it falls due either way.
en: Everything pays 70% more tonight. The ante is up a fifth, and it falls due either way.
fr: Tout paie 70 % de plus ce soir. L'ante augmente d'un cinquième, et elle est due de toute façon.

keys: Sixteen more sevens are printed onto the drum. The bells come back from the press worth nothing.
en: Sixteen more sevens are printed onto the drum. The bells come back from the press worth nothing.
fr: Seize sept chanceux de plus sont imprimés sur le tambour. Les cloches ressortent de la presse sans aucune valeur.

keys: Two nudges come with every award. Eight more skulls are printed onto the drum, for the practice.
en: Two nudges come with every award. Eight more skulls are printed onto the drum, for the practice.
fr: Deux poussées accompagnent chaque récompense. Huit crânes de plus sont imprimés sur le tambour, pour la pratique.

keys: A jaw is no use without something to close against. +2.0x while you own the Reel Clamp.
en: A jaw is no use without something to close against. +2.0x while you own the Reel Clamp.
fr: Une mâchoire ne sert à rien sans quelque chose contre quoi se refermer. +2,0x tant que vous possédez la Pince à Rouleau.

keys: The clause that pays when the worst of it happens. Each skull pays 5 instead of costing you.
en: The clause that pays when the worst of it happens. Each skull pays 5 instead of costing you.
fr: La clause qui paie quand le pire arrive. Chaque crâne paie 5 au lieu de vous coûter.

keys: Highest at the start of a floor, and falling from there. +0.12x per spin left on the floor, up to +2.0x.
en: Highest at the start of a floor, and falling from there. +0.12x per spin left on the floor, up to +2.0x.
fr: Au plus haut au début de l'étage, puis en baisse. +0,12x par lancer restant sur l'étage, jusqu'à +2,0x.

keys: The House counts the dead the way it counts everything. +1.2x per skull standing.
en: The House counts the dead the way it counts everything. +1.2x per skull standing.
fr: La Maison compte les morts comme elle compte tout le reste. +1,2x par crâne debout.

keys: The frame takes the strain the drums will not. +2.4x per reel held for the spin.
en: The frame takes the strain the drums will not. +2.4x per reel held for the spin.

keys: Win, and say nothing about it. The House notices 15% less of what you win.
en: Win, and say nothing about it. The House notices 15% less of what you win.
fr: Gagnez, et n'en dites rien. La Maison remarque 15 % de moins de ce que vous gagnez.

keys: Nothing on the first floor, and a little more on every one after it. +0.2x for every floor already cleared.
en: Nothing on the first floor, and a little more on every one after it. +0.2x for every floor already cleared.

keys: Two drums held and the third obliging. Pair lines gain +2.8x.
en: Two drums held and the third obliging. Pair lines gain +2.8x.

keys: A tooth for every stop the board owes. Every award the machine makes carries 3 more nudges.
en: A tooth for every stop the board owes. Every award the machine makes carries 3 more nudges.
fr: Une dent pour chaque arrêt que le plateau doit. Chaque récompense de la machine porte 3 poussées de plus.

keys: One page for every account you have opened. +0.25x per bank device owned.
en: One page for every account you have opened. +0.25x per bank device owned.

keys: A sum too small for the House to bother counting. Every spin pays 6 more, win or lose.
en: A sum too small for the House to bother counting. Every spin pays 6 more, win or lose.
fr: Une somme trop modeste pour que la Maison prenne la peine de la compter. Chaque lancer paie 6 de plus, qu'il gagne ou qu'il perde.

keys: The book keeps a column for it. +0.35x per paying spin in a row, up to +4.0x.
en: The book keeps a column for it. +0.35x per paying spin in a row, up to +4.0x.
fr: Le registre lui tient une colonne. +0,35x par lancer payant d'affilée, jusqu'à +4,0x.

keys: The limit is where the House expects a debtor to stop. +1.5x per stake level above the first.
en: The limit is where the House expects a debtor to stop. +1.5x per stake level above the first.
fr: La limite, c'est là où la Maison s'attend à ce qu'un débiteur s'arrête. +1,5x par niveau de mise au-dessus du premier.

keys: It reads what you signed, not what you hold. +0.8x for every 100 owed, up to +6.0x.
en: It reads what you signed, not what you hold. +0.8x for every 100 owed, up to +6.0x.
fr: Elle lit ce que vous avez signé, pas ce que vous détenez. +0,8x par tranche de 100 dus, jusqu'à +6,0x.

keys: One grip is a hold. Two is an arrangement. +3.0x while you own Lockstep.
en: One grip is a hold. Two is an arrangement. +3.0x while you own Lockstep.
fr: Une prise, c'est une retenue. Deux, c'est un arrangement. +3,0x tant que vous possédez le Pas Cadencé.

keys: It reads the part of the drop nobody else can see. +1.8x per nudge spent on the board.
en: It reads the part of the drop nobody else can see. +1.8x per nudge spent on the board.
fr: Il lit la part de la chute que personne d'autre ne voit. +1,8x par poussée dépensée sur le plateau.

keys: The stipend is being held back against a shortfall on another floor. Fewer chips at the close, and less asked in credit at the door.
en: The stipend is being held back against a shortfall on another floor. Fewer chips at the close, and less asked in credit at the door.
fr: L'allocation est retenue contre un déficit sur un autre étage. Moins de jetons à la clôture, et moins demandé en crédit à la porte.

keys: The strip came back cut in even lengths. Nothing on it is rare tonight, and the door is dearer for the fact.
en: The strip came back cut in even lengths. Nothing on it is rare tonight, and the door is dearer for the fact.
fr: La bande est revenue coupée en longueurs égales. Rien dessus n'est rare ce soir, et la porte en coûte plus cher.

keys: There was not enough stock for a full strip. Less of everything, next to none of the rarest, and a spin added to make up the difference.
en: There was not enough stock for a full strip. Less of everything, next to none of the rarest, and a spin added to make up the difference.
fr: Il n'y avait pas assez de stock pour une bande complète. Moins de tout, presque rien des plus rares, et un lancer ajouté pour compenser.

keys: Somebody on the late shift has been printing jokers. They stand in for anything, and the House charges for anything.
en: Somebody on the late shift has been printing jokers. They stand in for anything, and the House charges for anything.
fr: Quelqu'un de l'équipe tardive a imprimé des jokers. Ils remplacent n'importe quoi, et la Maison facture n'importe quoi.

keys: The skulls were printed twice over and nobody stopped the run. What gets past them is paid at a better rate.
en: The skulls were printed twice over and nobody stopped the run. What gets past them is paid at a better rate.
fr: Les crânes ont été imprimés deux fois, et personne n'a arrêté le tirage. Ce qui passe malgré eux est payé à un meilleur taux.

keys: The fruit has been struck off the strip. What is left is worth more and matches less often, and the House lets the door go cheaper.
en: The fruit has been struck off the strip. What is left is worth more and matches less often, and the House lets the door go cheaper.
fr: Les fruits ont été retirés de la bande. Ce qui reste vaut plus et s'assortit moins souvent, et la Maison laisse la porte moins chère.

keys: The room sits late. Two spins more on the allowance, the machines a shade colder for them, and the door dearer at the end.
en: The room sits late. Two spins more on the allowance, the machines a shade colder for them, and the door dearer at the end.
fr: La salle veille tard. Deux lancers de plus sur l'allocation, les machines un peu plus froides pour eux, et la porte plus chère à la fin.

keys: The cage has stamped its own mark the length of the strip. It pays in scrip wherever it lands, and the House takes the difference in credit at the door.
en: The cage has stamped its own mark the length of the strip. It pays in scrip wherever it lands, and the House takes the difference in credit at the door.
fr: La caisse a apposé sa propre marque sur toute la longueur de la bande. Elle paie en jetons partout où elle tombe, et la Maison prend la différence en crédit à la porte.

en: The vig on this floor is deferred. It is folded into the principal, and the House does not forget it.

en: The next spin, the last drum lands on a diamond. Ice like that does not mark itself.

en: Seven more pulls on the floor that keeps its own count. Signed by somebody who had nowhere else to be.

fr: The last drum, turned again, on the one floor where the House is also playing. Dearer again, and the House still signs it.

en: He collects what the Loan Shark lent. +3.0x while you own the Loan Shark.
fr: He collects what the Loan Shark lent. +3.0x while you own the Loan Shark.

en: Every creditor on the machine has been sold to one buyer. +0.45x per bank device owned.
fr: Every creditor on the machine has been sold to one buyer. +0.45x per bank device owned.

keys: The orchard goes down as far as it goes up. +9 draw weight on every fruit.
en: The orchard goes down as far as it goes up. +9 draw weight on every fruit.
